model: INMBSFGL001R000 Fujitsu AC to Modbus RTU gateway
applies_to: One Fujitsu indoor unit, or a group of up to 16 controlled together as one, on the 3-wire BWR remote-controller bus via INMBSFGL001R000, user manual v2.4 (02/2025).
summary: Modbus RTU server that connects to the 3-wire remote-controller (BWR) bus of a Fujitsu indoor unit. Holding registers give on/off, mode, fan, vanes, economy, setpoint and limits, room temperature, alarm and error code, plus window-contact and external-temperature functions.

addressing.note: Tables give a 'protocol address' (base 0) and a 'PLC address' (base 1); the protocol address is the wire address and is used for 'documented'.

source.title: Intesis INMBSFGL001R000 Modbus RTU Gateway for Fujitsu air conditioners - User's Manual

notes: Every register is documented as a 16-bit unsigned holding register and no temperature range in the manual goes below zero, so temperatures are UINT16. The 'no value' marker the manual writes as -32768 is raw 0x8000 (32768) and is listed as an enum entry. A value of 0 in the setpoint / reference registers means 'undetermined'.

Temperature registers depend on DIP SW4: x1 °C, x10 °C (decidegrees) or °F (no °F x10). The register-table footnote calls x10 the default, but the SW4 table and the quick-start page (all other switches off) give x1 °C as the factory setting, so scale 1 / °C is used. Read SW4 position 1-2 on site: if x10 is set use scale 0.1; if °F is set the values are whole °F.
Error code enum (Fujitsu codes) not reproduced; see manual section 7.
Unlike sibling Intesis gateways, this one passes the external temperature (reg 22) straight to the unit as its thermostat sensor rather than using a virtual-temperature setpoint offset.

integration.summary: Set SW1 for the BWR-bus role (master by default, slave if a Fujitsu wired remote is present) and the machine type, set address and baud on SW3/SW4, power-cycle, then poll holding registers 0-11 with function 03 and write with 06.
integration.enable: No enable step; register 7 (gateway disablement) must be 0 for commands to reach the unit.
quirks: Temperature scale depends on DIP SW4 and the manual is inconsistent about the factory default.
Vane pulse registers 27 and 34 are write-only steps, not positions.
Function 16 is accepted only with a quantity of one register; at most 100 registers per read.
setup: SW1: BWR-bus master (default, no Fujitsu remote) or slave (with a Fujitsu wired remote as master); machine-type switch.
SW3: slave address; SW3/SW4: baud (9600 default).
DIP changes need a power cycle. BWR bus max 500 m, not polarity sensitive.
gotchas: Set the SW1 machine-type switch to match the Fujitsu range: default covers RAC inverter G series and VRF J-II / V-II / VR-II; the other position covers RAC inverter / non-inverter and VRF V, S and J.

Register 22 (external temperature) only works if the indoor unit is set to use the remote-controller thermostat (Fujitsu function 42 = 1, set by an installer) and has no effect on RAC/domestic splits that need an extra comms accessory.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
